description: Vicmap Lite - Railway Line - 1:250,000 to 1:5,000,000 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport and Planning. This layer is part of Vicmap Lite and contains line features delineating railway features. Vicmap Lite datasets are suited for use between scales of 1: 250,000 and 1: 5 million. The linework was sourced from Vicmap Transport. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Transport and Planning . Its tags are Transportation. It offers 9 resource(s) in DWG, DXF, EXTENDED TAB, GDB, MIF. The portal shows 2026-07-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
